title: Fix WebView2 Stale Lock Race, Steer Zombie Agent, and Async Worktree State Sync
summary: Fixed Red Team audit issues 1.2, 1.4, 1.5: 1) eliminated premature %LOCALAPPDATA% lock deletion and removed hardcoded 154 WebView2 path, moving stale lock recovery to primary instance setup hook; 2) eliminated race condition and zombie agent in steer_agent by tracking ActiveAgentHandle with JoinHandle and atomic pointer equality cleanup; 3) replaced synchronous std::fs calls with tokio::fs during worktree .cvh runtime state synchronization.
notes: Verified on Windows with MSVC toolchain. Unit tests updated to #[tokio::test] async fn and passing cleanly.
